title_en: Jobs (18/20): An Accountant Balances the Books
note_en: Verb + 得 + description tells you how well or to what degree an action turned out: 把账目理得清清楚楚 "to get the accounts perfectly straight" and 把报表做得分毫不差 "to make a report accurate to the last cent." Here 得 is combined with the 把 pattern, and the doubled adjective 清清楚楚 makes the result vivid, much as English stacks adverbs like "perfectly" or "spotlessly."
